_note: The shared UI sound kit (spliced soundkit). crisp, tactile, in the spirit of the iPhone keyboard, all original ElevenLabs Sound Effects v3 takes. levels: kind -> [peak dBFS of one hit, low-pass Hz]; a film can override them (LEVELS in its sound_events.py). kinds: kind -> sources, each cut at `at` for `len` s, or every onset (`onsets`), or whole (`whole`, faded; `mid` keeps that many seconds either side of the middle).
